@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M5PSSH0ZM67NDH6CJ65KAKHP
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: Call the model through Extras PooledGeneration, with no whole-call queue job
+---
+## What
+
+Stop submitting whole SDK calls to the per-model `GenerationQueue`. Each routed generation calls the model through Extras `PooledGeneration` (the direct MLX call, with the in-flight meter and the cancel). Only MLX's lock serializes, and only for one generation. Tool bodies run outside every lock.
+
+**Depends on FoundationModelsExtras** (other board): "Call the MLX model directly, with an in-flight meter and a cancel that does not wait for the MLX lock" (01M5PSQ1XBPRF64B1NPTCWS0HJ). Start this task when it is on Extras main, and `swift package update` resolves it.
+
+**Why.** bench24-1023b, django__django-14999: the root started a diagnose child at 07:30:16 UTC. The child's first generation started at 07:53:31, after the root's one SDK call ended. That call was one queue job for 23 min. Transcripts: FoundationModelsACPAgent `bench/preds.bench24-1023b.transcripts/django__django-14999/` (root `01M5PD1HK75AXDHWGW9C9ATHR5`, child `agent-runs/01M5PD2HHJEYZZCTNHR3XE4NR6`).
+
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Resolution/LiveModelLoader.swift` (around 62-98, 143, 300): the backend model calls the real model through `PooledGeneration`, not through `submitting(to: queue)`.
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSessionActorAnswerExecution.swift` (about lines 1005-1021) and `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSessionActorCompaction.swift:473`: remove `target.queue.submit`. Keep the task-local wrapper `Self.submission(...)` (946-977), because the tool bodies read its bindings. Run it directly in the `modelCall` task.
+- [ ] **Keep the start wiring.** `run(_:on:...)` at `:1016-1020` is the only caller of `observer.submissionStarted()` and `onStart`. Call both when the SDK call starts. `SessionEvent.submissionStarted`, the stall watch (`GenerationStall.swift:293`), time to first token and the ACP agent's `promptDidStart` (`SessionProjector.swift:392`) depend on it. `submissionQueued` no longer has a cause. Stop sending it, and name each consumer you changed, the ACP agent's `ACPEventTranslator.swift:370` included. If the ACP agent needs a change, tell its session.
+- [ ] Restate the tests that pin the whole-call job (below).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] **Regression (fails before the change):** a parent routed session runs one SDK call with a tool body that waits until the test signals it. A child routed session on the same model generates during that wait, and its first generation ends before the parent's call ends.
+- [ ] **A tool that uses the same model completes:** a routed session's tool body runs an other routed session on the same model in-band and gets its answer.
+- [ ] `submissionStarted` and `submissionEnded` come once for each SDK call. The stall watch still arms.
+- [ ] `rg -n 'queue\.submit' Sources` finds no whole-call submit.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] New: `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/ChildStarvationRegressionTests.swift` (write it first, and see it fail). Stub generations use a FIFO serial lock, as MLX does, and wait on signals.
+- [ ] Restate `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/GenerationQueueSubmissionTests.swift`: `aToolBodyThatWaitsHoldsTheModelUntilItsSubmissionEnds` becomes "a tool body that waits holds nothing", and `twoToolLoopsRunWholeSubmissionsInOrder` becomes "they take turns per generation".
+- [ ] Restate or remove as necessary: `GenerationQueueTests`, `SubmissionQueueSpikeTests` (`aChildResultDeliveredAsMailCausesTheNextSubmission` must still pass), `SharedGenerationQueueContentionTests`, `SummarizerSubmissionTests`, `QueuedPassStallWatchTests`, `PooledResidencyTests`, `SessionChokepointTests`, `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterPublicSurfaceTests/GenerationQueuePublicSurfaceTests`. `ExecutorPassBoundaryTests` must still pass.
+- [ ] `swift test` in FoundationModelsRouter: all tests pass, with no new warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then implement until they pass.
+- After the push, tell the FoundationModelsMultitool session: `SearchToolsTool+Seams.swift:30-41` (the selection model must not be the caller's model) is no longer necessary. #no-queue
\ No newline at end of file
